admin.srv.reports.savings.assumption_ai: AI-recognized referral analysis: gives the team back {ahorro} min per case (it used to read/transcribe/validate the referral by hand ≈{manual} min; now it reviews the AI's prefill ≈{ai} min).
admin.srv.reports.savings.assumption_dol: Dollar rate used only to compare AI spend in USD against the hours given back: AR$ {dolar} (not a live quote).
admin.srv.reports.savings.assumption_hou: Municipal administrative hour cost used to translate that time into coverage hours: AR$ {costo} (2026 estimate).
admin.srv.reports.savings.assumption_ocr: Recognized DNI OCR (front or back): gives back {min} min per read that used to be entered by hand.
admin.srv.reports.savings.assumption_puc: PUCO lookup with coverage found at sign-up: gives back {min} min per account that used to be asked/typed by hand.
admin.srv.reports.savings.assumption_rec: Only AI calls marked 'recognized' count (they pulled out something useful): an unreadable document doesn't free up any time, the team reviews it anyway — without penalizing anyone for it.
admin.srv.reports.savings.assumption_rem: Automatic reminder the day before: gives back {min} min per appointment that used to be a manual call or message.
admin.srv.reports.season.assumption: Assumes peak-season demand multiplies the last 8 weeks' observed demand by {factor}× (TURNOS_SEASON_FACTOR environment variable) — there isn't yet enough of the installation's own seasonal history to measure it, so this is a stated projection, not a measurement.
